current_semantics.restore_checkpoint_progress_choice: for incoming transcripts with >1 non-system message, persistCompletedToolProgress receives caller messages instead of merged durable history
current_semantics.reproduction: stored assistant turn contains two accepted mutating calls A and B; caller returns a truncated explicit transcript containing only call A plus result A

risk: A stale/truncated OpenAI-compatible transcript can acknowledge one accepted mutating tool call while accidentally deleting an unresolved sibling from durable state. A later restart then sees no pending obligation and may plan/replay work over an unknown side effect. The same overwrite also drops stored system history when the caller omits it.

candidate_contract.rule: tool-result progress must be persisted from the authoritative merged history, never from a caller transcript that can erase previously accepted unresolved calls
candidate_contract.minimal_change: inside restoreCheckpoint use mergedMessages for persistCompletedToolProgress regardless of incoming transcript length; the function may still return caller messages for the immediate provider request if that compatibility behavior is intentionally retained

coordination: Not current Qwen Core mixed-stream checkpoint work, not Qwen Reliability request-wide retry/account accounting, and does not touch Notion lanes.
limits: No production, real accounts, user data or secrets
